pages.description: Capture a gentle emotional moment with this unique My Little Pony coloring page featuring a sad Fluttershy looking down with tears in her big expressive eyes. Surrounded by floating donuts, cupcakes, wrapped candies, and sprinkles, this high-contrast outline drawing offers a sweet and tender art experience for toddlers, elementary kids, and MLP fans. Download and print this sheet at home for a therapeutic coloring session with markers or colored pencils.
